statement: The two caustic demonstrations do not run from what git holds: .gitignore:90 (`**/solution/`) ignores the sealed mirror constant/parameters/solution/NaOH-water.dat that both manifests name (propertyManifest:91).  A `git archive` export of liquidDensity03_NaOH exits 2, 'No solution record covers this set'.  check_density_pilot then fails and ends in a traceback; check_sealed_corpus passes with a manifest naming a record not on disk.  Reproduced by the reviewing session (the export and the run).

A marked measurement (`use method; replaces { method idealMixing; }`) over a set with a massWithoutVolume leaf never returns: DensityResolver.cpp:398 holds its mutex across the build of the measurement, which evaluates the replaced method, which calls noteMassWithoutVolume (:438) and takes the same mutex.  Reproduced by the reviewing session: killed by a 40 s limit; the same case with `use check;` exits 0.

A per-unit thermo{} world with the same components and another formulation is refused as 'resolved to ... earlier in this run and to ... now': the resolver's package identity (DensityResolver.cpp:69-75) is component names plus pure-fluid selections only.  Reviewer's measurement, twice; not rerun by the reviewing session.

massWithoutVolume declared for a component that has a volume is ignored by the density and read by the pump's heat-capacity share: liquidDensity02 plus the declaration for ethanol keeps its density and W_shaft, never mentions the declaration, and moves the pump's dT from 0.0285 to 0.0427 K and its energy row from 30.00 % to 44.88 % closure.  Reproduced by the reviewing session.

A marked measurement whose constituent set matches no unit's set is silently never used: liquidDensity04 with its column renamed w[NaHO] exits 0, the CSTR priced by the catalogue law (tau 1212.70 s where the measurement gives 1213.80 s), and no line names the unmatched measurement.  Reproduced by the reviewing session.

Unknown keys inside the new blocks are accepted in silence (a misspelt key under replaces, an extra box key, an extra file key, an extra key in the law block and in massWithoutVolume, a component name not in the case); the top-level words and mandatory keys do refuse by name.

No refusal of the new kernel prints its remedy: the remedy field of the property-domain error is copied once and printed nowhere, while the Theory Guide and the plan say the failure carries its remedy.
The remedy the mixed-solvent refusal names (a ternary solution record) cannot be written: the record grammar holds one solute and one solvent, and a ternary file ends in a logic error.

On main too: a stream declaring T and vapour fraction and no P reaches the units with P = 0 (StreamStateIO.cpp:3171 defaults it; the over-specification check needs both T and P).  Pure water is then refused as 'a vapour' for the wrong reason; water plus ethanol exits 0 with a pump publishing P_in 0; the caustic case drops the pressure from its table.  Reviewer's measurement, twice.

The rejectable trial works end to end (a designSpec whose full steps cross the hypothesis bound has every trial rejected and the step halved) but the run never says why: the bound's message appears nowhere in the log, the solver only reports 'every trial infeasible or non-finite', and the result block says converged true for the flowsheet pass beside an outer loop that did not converge.

check_liquid_density_entry_callers' pattern matches only the namespace-qualified call while its docstring says it counts unqualified calls inside the namespace: two new callers added on a scratch copy leave the gate printing OK.

Built and read by nothing: passedOver, the two run-level tallies and the quality record (domain, evidence, origin, provenance); the plan's section 2 table and the D2 printed-evidence condition recorded in DEV.md are neither built nor checked.

'Same liquid, two numbers' is not printed: pumpSystem01 prices one water at 997.14 kg/m3 in the pump (kernel) and 996.93 to 996.95 in the pipe (door, record volume) with no line saying so; the comparison keys on an exact state tuple.
The reference equation's declared lower temperature limit is not honoured or announced: the kernel answers 991.24 kg/m3 for water at 250 K and 1 bar (the record declares 251.165 K) with no advisory.

settled-contracts.md says the vapour side of a pure fluid's band is a typed domain error and that the refusal names every method passed over; the code prices a saturated liquid for a leaf in a mixture and for a one-constituent reference set between the two lines, and the refusal names only the missing leaves.
docs/design/density-pilot-plan.md:3 still reads 'Status: OPEN -- nothing built' and is the settled contract's record; six deviations from the plan are recorded only in commit messages.
The box judgement of a measurement re-evaluates the replaced method at every box corner on every density request, with its announcements raised at states the run never visits (by reading).
Prose: the NaOH-water record header says the run announces 'no pressure term' once per unit (the code says it only above 2 MPa); a negative pressure is described as vapour.
Process-lifetime static caches keyed by path or equation name; the WebAssembly build runs several cases per process (not reproduced; native build only).

The two water demonstrations ship with their pump's first law open and pinned at 70 %: liquidDensity01 publishes '30.000000 % closure', residual = eta x W_shaft; with a pure-fluid method selected on a copy the plant closes at -4.6e-12 kW and dT goes from 0.0205 to 0.0242 K.  The pump's known debt (pump01/pump02 carry the same pin at 65 % on main); the report says it cannot attribute a residual the pump's own advisory attributes.  Reproduced by the reviewing session.
liquidDensity01's flowsheet header says tau = 997.047 s; the run and the golden give 997.132 s (the CSTR prices its feed, the pump's outlet at 3 bar).  Reproduced by the reviewing session.

The propertySources label says 'pressure not applied' on an ideal-mixing set whose water leaf is compressed: liquidDensity02 publishes 888.28 kg/m3 at 1 bar and 888.29 at 3 bar under that label.  Reproduced by the reviewing session.

No check in git sees the temperature shape of a Rackett leaf: ethanol's acentric factor set to 0 on a copy moves the mixture density at 323.15 K by +0.31 % and every gate arm still passes; the -7.1 % move of the 350 K esterification reactors' residence time is almost all that shape.

Water's vapour-pressure fit, extrapolated above its declared range, lies above the reference line from about 311 K (+8.8 % at 450 K, +19 % at 610 K); between the two lines the kernel returns a compressed liquid with no announcement while the package calls the state a vapour.  It changes which states are answered, not a density.

'30 of 32 move as the plan measured' holds as a count; the members differ from the plan's (pump01/pump02 move, cstr02 does not) and three predicted sizes changed because water became the reference equation.  Every moved row read carries a stated reason.
The pump's incompressible route uses the inlet volume times dP and drops the alpha T v dP part of the temperature rise (0.0205 K against 0.0242 K on the reference route for liquidDensity01).
By ruling, the CSTR's concentrations use the feed's volumetric flow; on cstr08 the outlet-state flow would differ by 0.74 %.
Not the pilot's: cstr08's component records give MW(propylene oxide) + MW(water) 4e-6 relative below MW(propanediol), so the stream mass rises across the reactor.

The same defect as PA-01, found independently, with two additions: the engine prints `[seal] MISSING ... (claimed, not on disk)` and CONTINUES before refusing for another reason; and no gate checks that a record a manifest claims is tracked by git.

A sealed case with no copy of the reference-equation record silently prices water by another method than its unsealed twin.  cstr01 with 0.2 kmol/h of water added to its feed: sealed 855.33 kg/m3 (anchored Rackett), unsealed 856.65 kg/m3 (IAPWS-95 plus Rackett); nothing announced.  Latent: 18 sealed pump or CSTR cases carry no copy, 14 with water as a component, none with water in the feed today.  Reproduced by the reviewing session.

The IAPWS-95 record's load-time check (the pressure at 300 K and 996.556 kg/m3 to nine digits) passes with a margin of 3.8e-10 relative, and a one-unit-in-the-last-place change of some `pow` results refuses the record ('check value NOT reproduced'), exit 2.  Since the pilot every pump or CSTR whose liquid holds water loads that record.  Reproduced by the reviewing session on liquidDensity02: exit 0 clean and with every 2nd or 5th result moved, exit 2 with every 3rd or 7th.  On main too for the cases that selected the equation; the pilot widened its reach.

A red test on the branch: the cstr08 re-record moved its three steady states (292.2 / 303.0 / 336.5 K to 292.43 / 302.61 / 336.55 K) and gui/src/ui/methods/vanHeerdenLesson.ts:296-297 still quotes the old ones; vanHeerdenLesson.test.ts fails (1 failed of 8045).  The test holds only one of the three.

Four engine sabotages survive every pilot gate and every golden of the 38-case pump and CSTR scope, alone and together: the pump head perturbed apart from the molar volume (2e-5), the reference leaf's volume (2e-6), ideal mixing of three or more constituents (2e-6 per constituent; the second demonstration tests only a binary), and the pressure-advisory threshold (2 MPa to 6 or 2000 MPa).
The same defect as PA-11, with a second form: a namespace alias also passes check_liquid_density_entry_callers.

Off the recording platform check_property_route_bench returns NO SUBJECT before running the bench, so the two platform-independent checks the pilot added to it (resolution by package and not by address; the domain error as an infeasible trial) are asserted by nothing there.  Run by hand the bench exits 0.

property_source_witnesses.tsv lost its rows for two source tags that PFR.cpp:201,700 and PressureExchanger.cpp:224 still record; 'one witness per source class' no longer holds and its gate does not notice.

On main too: a sealed case reads the installation catalogue.  SolutionRegistry::loadFrom and the utility catalogue have no sealed test; with the catalogue hidden ChemicalPlantTutorial and sugarPlantEconomicsSweep exit 2 and cstr01 and rankine02 change their utility allocation.

check_liquid_cp_fallback's probe (critical temperature moved from 300 to 400 K) no longer exercises the branch above the critical temperature that its docstring gives as the fallback's reason; its claim line still says 'above Tc that is the ideal-gas enthalpy' for a number that now includes 8052.43 J/mol of latent heat.  Behind it: a liquid feed with a component above its critical temperature and no declared hypothesis is now refused where it was priced on the flat record volume; no corpus case meets it.
check_density_pilot ends in a traceback when a subject cannot run; its 'measured' wiring arm uses one state, so its two-states arm never runs for that method.

The time-integrated units do not reach the new entry (VariableVolumeHoldup.cpp:93 still uses the earlier evaluation): the same water is priced by anchored Rackett in a dynamic tank and by IAPWS-95 in a steady pump, not stated in the plan's scope.
seal_reference_records.py writes copies without the importer's header line, so a later import rewrites them; its --check is wired into no gate.
bin/runTests lists liquidDensity05 and 06 under 'deliberate teaching non-convergence'; they are refusals.
swro01_campoDalias differs between its sealed and unsealed runs by 1e-9 to 2.6e-7 relative, inside its goldens; not attributed (measured once).

Extends PC-03: two more checks of the water record sit closer to their edge than the reproduced one (the pressure at 500 K and 1084.564 kg/m3: computed 700000405.495 against 700000405, 0.990 of the half unit, margin 7.1e-12 relative; rhoV on saturation at 275 K, 0.992); the other three reference records print four to six digits and their margins are about 1e-7.  Measured by the reviewing session on an unmodified run of refEoS01.
